items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I saw Jack Johnson and Jess Willard fight.

ctx.x: Uh - huh. And what were your favorite games as a child? Do you remember?
Baseball, boxing - as a matter of fact, I saw Jack Johnson and Jess Willard fight.
You saw the Jess Willard - Jack Johnson fight. What do you remember about that? Who took you to the fight?
